_comment: Template for ../.mcp.json — CC-09's SQL tool. Copy it up one level, replace both
absolute paths, and Claude Code will offer to trust the server on next start.
This server is deliberately SEPARATE from the machine's ordinary SQL MCP server:
it reads a connections file that holds exactly one entry, a read-only SQLite file
of synthetic rows. A session whose job is to emit PII then has no reachable path
to a production table — 'never point this at a real table' becomes a property of
the wiring instead of a warning in a doc.
Create cc09.db out-of-band from fixtures/cc09-setup.sql — never through the proxy.
Any MCP server that can serve a local SQLite file works; this one is what the

cc09-sqlite.command: <abs path to your SQL MCP server executable>
